column1: # Swedish diacritic-fold table (D-436) - base letter -> every real variant, so a token typed without it
# ("ar") still reaches the correctly-spelled word ("är"/"år"), both live while typing and at autocorrect/
# split-repair time. å/ä/ö are traditionally treated as their own additional letters in the Swedish alphabet
# (not merely accented a/o), but the same base-letter-fold mechanism still applies for typing convenience.
